title: Guyana Gusher
summary:
Latin American producer shows enormous potential
Every oil production outlook for 2020 and beyond needs to consider the enormous potential represented by Guyana, a small Latin American country with a total population of about 800,000 tucked in between Venezuela, Brazil and Suriname (all oil producers). By far the largest player in the country is ExxonMobil, with its partners Hess and China National Offshore Oil Corp. In 2015 Exxon made a discovery offshore Guyana in the Stabroek exploration block and since then it has found so much more oil that Guyana could become one of the largest oil producers in the world on a per capita basis.
